blue.limitations: The assessment of lung volumes is based on a single frontal and lateral chest radiograph, which may not fully capture dynamic lung function. Patient positioning and inspiration effort can influence the appearance of lung volumes on radiographs. The images provided are a single PA and lateral chest X-ray, which may not be sufficient to definitively characterize subtle infiltrates or differentiate them from other causes of increased opacity such as atelectasis or vascular engorgement. The quality of the images is adequate for general assessment, but detailed evaluation of lung parenchyma can be limited by projectional overlap and patient positioning.
